findings: The hybrid protects the first max_num_seqs waiting requests in each cohort, then prioritizes cached prefixes.
In the A-Y workload, hybrid A/B median first-text latency was about 3.3s versus about 10.8s for prefix-first.
The hybrid did not establish an overall latency/throughput advantage over FCFS in these workloads.
Three matched timed runs per policy; diagnostic tracing was separate from timings.
reproduce: See configs/hybrid-prefix.txt and configs/prefix-comparison.txt; source and harness are checkpointed on the completed branch in their respective Git repos.
